new_task_1.title: Resolve latest cached recipe revisions before cache path lookups
new_task_1.description: Conan 2.16.0 fixes cache path resolution so recipe-path APIs and local cache lookups resolve an unspecified or `latest` recipe revision to the actual latest cached revision before reading cache layouts. This keeps export, export_sources, and source folder resolution working for callers that do not pin an exact revision.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that cache-backed recipe path resolution works when callers provide a recipe reference without an exact revision, by resolving the current latest cached revision before looking up the recipe layout.

expectation.grounded: `CacheAPI.export_path()`, `CacheAPI.export_source_path()`, and `CacheAPI.source_path()` should resolve a reference that uses `revision="latest"` or otherwise omits a concrete revision to the current latest cached `RecipeReference` before calling into `PkgCache.recipe_layout()`. Local cache recipe resolution in the graph proxy should likewise resolve the latest cached recipe reference when the requested reference has no revision.
expectation.conceptual: Users and integrations should be able to ask Conan for recipe cache paths or reuse a locally cached recipe without having to pre-resolve the exact revision themselves.

constraints.grounded: If the caller provides an exact revision, Conan should continue to use that revision directly. If no cached revision exists, the existing not-found behavior should remain unchanged. The change should only affect how missing or `latest` revisions are resolved before cache layout access.
constraints.conceptual: The fix should preserve explicit revision semantics while restoring the expected latest-revision behavior for unpinned cache lookups.

behavior: Cache path helpers now resolve the latest cached recipe revision before returning export, export_sources, or source paths when the input reference is not pinned to an exact revision.
Local cache recipe resolution in dependency graph processing now resolves the latest cached recipe reference before attempting a cache layout lookup.
Cache layout lookup now assumes it is operating on a concrete revision rather than treating an unset revision as an implicit latest lookup.
acceptance_criteria: When a caller requests `export_path`, `export_source_path`, or `source_path` for a recipe reference whose revision is `latest`, Conan should resolve that request to the current latest cached recipe revision and return the corresponding path if it exists.

When a caller requests those cache paths for a recipe reference with no explicit revision and the recipe exists in cache, Conan should resolve and use the latest cached revision rather than failing because the revision is unset.
When dependency graph resolution checks the local cache for a recipe reference without an explicit revision, it should use the latest cached recipe revision for the cache lookup.
When a caller provides an exact revision, Conan should continue to use that exact revision and should not silently replace it with another cached revision.

new_task_2.title: Suppress the generic connection banner during remote authentication
new_task_2.description: Conan 2.16.0 removes the generic `Connecting to remote ...` info line from the authenticate path used by remote login, so `conan remote login` reports the actual login result without the extra connection preamble.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that remote authentication output does not emit the generic connection banner during `authenticate`, so `conan remote login` output stays focused on the login result itself.

expectation.grounded: When `ConanApiAuthManager.call_rest_api_method()` is invoked for the `authenticate` method, credential lookup should not print the `Connecting to remote '<name>' ...` info message. Authentication should still proceed with the resolved credentials, and the normal login result output should still be produced.
expectation.conceptual: Users logging into a remote should see the meaningful authentication result without an extra informational line that does not add value to the login flow.

constraints.grounded: The change should only suppress the informational banner for the `authenticate` path. Credential resolution and authentication behavior must remain unchanged, and non-authentication REST calls may continue to print the connection banner when credentials are first loaded.
constraints.conceptual: This should be a CLI output cleanup, not a change in how remotes are authenticated or how credentials are selected.

behavior: `conan remote login` no longer prints the generic `Connecting to remote ...` line when performing authentication.
Remote authentication still uses the same resolved credentials and reports the login outcome normally.
The generic connection banner remains available for other remote REST calls outside the authenticate path.
acceptance_criteria: When a user runs `conan remote login` against a configured remote, the command output should not contain `Connecting to remote` solely because authentication is being performed.
When that login succeeds or changes the active user, Conan should still report the resulting login state through the normal login-result output.
When other remote REST operations resolve credentials outside the authenticate path, they may still print the generic connection banner as before.
